title: Pack manifest (pack.yaml)
description: A pack is the unit you install and share: modes, roles, skills, principles and optionally agents or the Chief of Staff.

summary.description: One line; the CoS sees this in its pack list

core.description: Version range of pm-os core, e.g. ^0.2

depends.description: Other packs this one uses, with version ranges: ["pm@^0.1"]

router.description: The pack's entry mode for goal-level asks

cos.description: Path to a Chief of Staff manual this pack supplies

exports.description: What other packs and the CoS may use. Anything not exported is internal to the pack.
